items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the cohomology of the projective line is one dimensional in degrees zero and two and vanishes in all other degrees (statement lines 2901-2906). The proof (proof lines 2907-2929) computes the class of the diagonal as a sum of two pure tensors, uses the diagonal lemma to bound the total dimension, and uses nonvanishing and Poincare duality to determine the two dimensions. H3: a short computation with a dimension count, written out in full.
